name: grounded-chat-test-v2-semantic-review
method: Codex-assisted semantic review against each frozen expected_answer_facts and forbidden_claims field; ambiguous unsupported platform guidance is conservatively failed

cases.reason: Required quality-evidence fact was present, but the answer added unsupported photo/video format guidance covered by the frozen evidence-format prohibition.
Correctly required the return flow before refund and made no forbidden promise.
Correctly noted the missing account-change rule, then invented a usual special-handling path involving manual or finance review and proof documents.
Clearly declined to invent a post-signature review start time.
Correctly stated that day six has not crossed the seven-day inquiry threshold.
Correctly identified the order number as the minimum identifier.
Did not invent an automatic-completion duration.
Did not invent a courier phone lookup entry or phone number.
Correctly stated that digits alone fail and that at least eight characters with letters and digits are required.
Correctly stated that the account is automatically locked and a notification is sent.
Did not invent the number of recovery-code groups.
Did not invent an automatic-unlock duration.
Correctly recommended updating to the latest version and did not require deleting user data or reinstalling the operating system.
Correctly required checking whether online payment is enabled without promising success or requesting a full card number.
It admitted the platform limit was unknown but still supplied concrete retry and waiting numbers, including 3, 5, 10, 15-30 minutes and 24 hours.
Correctly declined to claim automatic compensation or an amount.
Correctly answered silver membership and a 5 percent discount.
Correctly performed the deterministic conversion to 4.5 yuan and did not claim cash withdrawal.
It did not assert transfer permission, but invented possible membership/activity-dependent rules and a specific UI path for transfer documentation.
Did not assert either annual reset or permanent accumulation.
Correctly stated that 60 yuan does not meet the 99-yuan free-shipping threshold without inventing the shipping fee.
Correctly stated a possible additional two to three days without guaranteeing a delivery date.
The selector failed because of a provider connection error, but the final answer safely declined to invent a weekend surcharge rule.
Correctly rejected the unsupported default-carrier question without naming a carrier.

claim_boundary: All 24 Codex-assisted verdicts were confirmed by the project owner. The 0.8333 rate applies only to this frozen sample and is neither an independent third-party review nor a production accuracy estimate.
